UBUMBANO, ezemfundo, ukubuyiswa komhlaba ngaphandle kwesinxephezelo, ezempilo, ukufukula ezomnotho, ukwakha amathuba emisebenzi, ngezinye zezinto okulindeleke ukuthi zibe seqhulwini enkulumeni yaminyaka yonke ye-ANC ezothulwa nguMengameli wale nhlangano, uMnuz Cyril Ramaphosa. Le nkulumo ibhekwe ngabomvu, ikakhulu kulo nyaka wokhetho, njengoba le nhlangano izobe ikhankasela ukuwina ukhetho ukuze igcine amandla okuhola uhulumeni kuleli ngaphandle kwaseWestern Cape lapho kuphethe iDA. Umgubho iJanuwari 8, uzoba senkundleni yezemidlalo iMoses Mabhida eThekwini kusasa. Le nhlangano imemezele ukuthi ilindele ukugcwalisa le nkundla emumatha abantu abangu-87 000. Abahlaziyi bezombusazwe abakhulume neSolezwe, bathe lezi zinto ezibalwe ngenhla yizona ezizobe zihamba phambili enkulumeni kaRamaphosa. Umhlaziyi, uMnuz Protas Madlala, uthe ucabanga ukuthi inkulumo kamengameli izogxila kakhulu odabeni lokudala amathuba emisebenzi nokufukula ezomnotho. "Angingabazi ukuthi uRamaphosa imkhathaza kakhulu indaba yomnotho wezwe osuhlale iside ungasimami yingakho enza konke okusemandleni ukuba kuguqulwe isimo somnotho wezwe," kusho uMadlala. Uthe ngeke ayishiye ngaphandle indaba yobumbano ikakhulukazi njengoba uhlangothi obeluhamba noDkt Nkosazana Dlamini Zuma, ngesikhathi kuyiwa eNasrec, kade lungamfuni. "Enye into engicabanga ukuthi uzoyikhuza, isihlava sokubulalana kosopolitiki esenzeka kakhulu lapha KwaZulu-Natal," kusho uMadlala. Omunye umhlaziyi wezepolitiki ozimele, uMnuz Bukani Mngoma, naye uhambe emazwini kaMadlala wathi ubona inkulumo kamengameli izogxila kakhulu ekudaleni amathuba emisebenzi nokufukula umnotho. "Udaba lwamathuba emisebenzi nezomnotho kuyahambisana. Enye into engicabanga ukuthi uzoyithinta, wudaba lwezemfundo nodaba lokubuyiswa komhlaba ngaphandle kwezinxephezelo," kusho uMngoma. Uthe ezemfundo zibalulekile ngoba ziyisikhali sezwe. Naye uRamaphosa ekhuluma kuleli sonto emgubheni weminyaka engu-107 kwabunjwa i-ANC oHlange, eNanda, ubalule ibanga eselihanjiwe kwezemfundo kuleli. Ubale ukunyuka kwemiphumela ka-matric unyaka nonyaka, isibalo esiphezulu sabafundi ababhala leli banga, ukudla ezikoleni, ukuthuthwa kwabafundi njengezinye zezinto le nhlangano ezenze ngempumelelo selokhu yathatha amandla ombuso. Ukhale ngabafundi abaqala isikole kodwa bangafinyeleli kwa-matric, wathi lokhu kuyabakhathaza. Ubale nokuthi uhulumeni wandise isibalo sabantu abasebenzayo kuleli. "Sathatha izintambo abantu abangu-8 million ababesebenza kuleli, sengeze ngabanye abangu-7 million asebesebenza manje selokhu sathatha izintambo." Umhlaba sizowuthatha ngaphandle kwesinxephezelo. Sizobhekana nokwahlukana, sizobumbana," kusho uRamaphosa ngamafuphi eNanda. Kuleli sonto, abaholi abahlukene abaphezulu bale nhlangano bankanise isifundazwe sonke benxenxa abantu ukuthi bathamele le nkulumo eMabhida. UMnuz Zizi Kodwa, obhekele ezokuxhumana ehhovisi likaRamaphosa kwi-ANC, uthe abantu bazogcwala nakwenye indawo abazobe behlelelwe kuyona uma sekugcwele eMabhida. "Zintathu kuphela izinhlangano ezikwazi ukugcwalisa izinkundla kuleli. I-ANC, iChiefs uma idlala nePirates nebandla iZCC. Sizoyigcwalisa iMabhida," kusho uKodwa. Le nhlangano ithe yonke into isimi ngomumo ngalo mgubho.

UNGAPHANSI kohlelo lokuvikelwa kofakazi owesilisa okusolwa ukuthi wadlelwa umakhelwane wakhe imali yefa eyashiywa wumqashi wakhe ayesemsebenzele iminyaka engaphezulu kweyishumi kwisithabathaba somuzi oseLa Lucia eThekwini. USabelo Mdlovu obesebenza engadini emzini kaNkk Charlotte Davies, umyeni wakhe owayedayisa idayimane (naye ongasekho emhlabeni). Ngokomunye womakhelwane abasondele emzini kaNkk Davies, wayengumuntu othulayo owayekhuluma noMdlovu kuphela isikhathi esiningi. Yingakho uMdlovu nabanye omakhelwane bathuka boma ngoSepthemba ngonyaka ka-2012 kutholakala ukuthi uNkk Davies ushiyele omunye umakhelwane, uNkk Adline Pillay, imali esondele kuR60 million, wabe eseshiyela uMdlovu uR600 000 kuphela. Ukusolisa kwalolu daba kuholele ophenyweni olwenziwa amaphoyisa eminyakeni emine edlule kanti abasolwa okunguPillay, abammeli bakhe ababili uMnuz Rodney Reddy noP. Ramjatham, bavele okokuqala enkantolo yamacala athinta imali ngoLwesine oludlule. Babhekene namacala enkohlakalo, ukukokotela kanye nokushushumbisa imali. Baboshwe kulandele isinqumo se-Assets Forfeiture Unit (AFU) sokugodla umuzi obiza uR5.8 million ngokunjalo nemali engaphezulu kuka R2.3 million ebikwi-akhawunti yakwaStandard Bank kamsolwa. UMdlovu uvulele uPillay icala ngosizo lommeli obengumakhelwane kaNkk Davies, uMnuz Ferdinand Zondagh kanti njengamanje ungaphansi kohlelo lokuvikelwa kofakazi njengoba esabela impilo yakhe. UZondagh uyena owakwazi ukuthola incwadi kaNkk Davies esayiniwe yango-2008, okuyiyo eyakubeka kwacaca ukuthi kukokotelwe ukusayinwa kwencwadi yamafa njengoba izandla zazingafani. Engxoxweni nephephandaba elinguzakwabo weSolezwe, iDaily News, uZondagh uthe uMdlovu waxhumana naye ngo-2014 wamazisa ukuthi kukhona okushaya amanzi ngencwadi yamafa kaNkk Davies. Noma aqale elekelela uMdlovu, uZondagh manje usemele abashana bakaNkk Davies, uMnuz Landgraf Pane noNkk Barbara Pane, abahlala eGermany. Ngokwamaphepha asenkantolo, lolu daba lwasuka ngoSepthemba ngonyaka ka-2012 uMdlovu efika emzini kaNkk Davies. Wangqongqoza izithuba eziningi engamtholi kwaze kwaba uthinta amaphoyisa afika ashaya phansi isicabha angena. UNkk Davies watholwa esedlulile emhlabeni. Kuvela ukuthi uMdlovu wacela uNksz Pillay ukuthi amlekelele ngamalungiselelo omngcwabo njengoba uNkk Davies wayengenazo izihlobo kuleli. UMdlovu wazisa amaphoyisa noPillay ukuthi kunesisefo (safe) endlini. Sesivuliwe, kwatholwa incwadi yamafa namanye amaphepha ambalwa. "UPillay noMdlovu baya kwaRodney & Reddy Associates, okungabameli ababhalisa uNkk Davies incwadi yakhe yamafa." Incwadi yakhe yokugcina yasayinwa ngoJanuwari 21 ngo-2010," ngokwamaphepha asenkantolo. Umhlaziyi wezobunhloli (forensic analyst) owaqhathanisa ukusayina kukaNkk Davies encwadini yango-2008 kanye nokusayina okubonakala encwadini yamafama wathola ukuthi kukokotelwe okusencwadini yamafa. Kule ncwadi uPillay uhlabana ngezigidi zikaNkk Davis, uMdlovu usala noR600 000 kuphela. Ngokwamaphepha asenkantolo, udaba luzobuyela enkantolo ngoFebruwari 4.-Daily News

IRa idume kakhulu eGauteng kwazise muva nje iyona ebikhipha abantu abebakhe imijondolo endaweni engafanele e-Alexandra. Isikhulu esiphezulu sePsira, uMnuz Manabela Chauke sithe iRed Ants inikezwe ithuba lokuthi iziphendulele ngaphambi kokuthi imiswe. Uthe inalo ilungelo lokuphikisa isinqumo sokumiswa kwayo. Bekungafanele uhulumeni achibiyele imithetho ethinta ukusebenza kwalezi zibhamu ngaphandle kokuxoxa nezinkampani zonogada. I-National Prosecuting Authority (NPA), Asset Forfeiture Unit (AFU), Specialised Commercial Crime Unit, aboMnyango weziMali, iFinancial Intelligence Centre, iCompanies and Intellectual Property Commission noKlebe bayasebenzisana kulo mzamo. Inhloko esabambile ye-AFU, u-Adv Knox Molelle, ithe basathumela amasamanisi kwabakwaGupta ophenyweni olusaqhubeka ngalabo abathinteka embikweni woMvikeli woMphakathi wokulawulwa kombuso yidlanzana. ABAHLAZIYI bepolitiki bathi uMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa uzama ukugaya amavoti njengoba kubhekwe okhethweni lwangonyaka ozayo, ngokusheshisa udaba lokuguqula isigatshana u25 soMthethosisekelo othinta udaba lo mhlaba. NgoLwesibili ebusuku uRamaphosa uvele kuSABC ememezela ukuthi i-ANC izovotela ukuthi kuchitshiyelwe lesi sigaba 25 soMthethosisekelo ukuze ithathe umhlaba wabantu abazimele ngaphandle kwesinxephezelo iwunike abawuswele. "Kuyasicacela sonke ukuthi abantu bakithi bafuna umthethosisekelo ucacise udaba lokubuyiswa komhlaba ngaphandle kwesinxephezelo," kusho uRamaphosa. Umhlaziyi wepolitiki uMnuz Thabani Khumalo uthe kusobala ukuthi uRamaphosa useqala ukukhankasa ngoba udaba lo mhlaba yilona olunyakazisa abantu kuwo wonke amazinga. "I-ANC isiyaxhamazela, ithatha umkhankaso we-EFF ibe ingazi ukuthi izowenza kanjani. Ayilwenzanga ucwaningo ebantwini, emakhosini nakuzo zonke izinhlaka ezithintekayo," kusho uRamaphosa. URamaphosa wenze isimemezelo yize izithangami zodaba lomhlaba zisaqhubeka, lokhu kukhombisa ngokusobala ukuthi akanazo izinhlelo ezicacile," kusho uKhumalo. Umhlaziyi we-EFF uMnuz Bukani Mngoma uthe kungenzeka ukuthi uRamaphosa ukhulume ngodaba lomhlaba ngoba efuna ukususa amehlo abantu kwi-EFF ebeyigubha iminyaka emihlanu yasungulwa futhi ikhuluma ngodaba lomhlaba. "Kungenzeka ukuthi ufuna ukukhombisa abanye kwi-ANC ukuthi ulusukumele phezulu udaba lo mhlaba ngoba beluvamise ukukhulunywa ngabantu akade beseka uDkt Nkosazana Dlamini-Zuma. Asingakhohlwa nokuthi sekusondele ukhetho futhi udaba lomhlaba yilona oluhamba phambili naye useqalile ukugaya ivoti," kusho uMngoma. Uthe inkulumo kaRamaphosa izodida abatshalizimali ngoba abasaqondi ukuthi uhulumeni umiphi odabeni lomhlaba nokuthi uma sewuwuthatha ngaphandle kwesinxephezelo imali yabo izophepha kangakanani. UKhumalo uthe abatshalizimali bazoba manqika ukuthi bafake imali yabo emnothweni waseNingizimu Afrika ngoba abazi ukuthi iphephe kangakanani. UMnuz Omri van Zyl ongoMqondisi we-AgriSA uthe uRamaphosa nesigungu esiphezulu bekufanele balinde imibono yabantu ngaphambi kokwenza isimemezelo. "Ukuchitshiyelwa kwesigaba esithile somthethosisekelo kusho ukuthi usengcupheni wonke umthethosisekelo," kusho uVan Zyl. Umholi weDA uMnuz Mmusi Maimane usole uRamaphosa ngokungahleleki nokungakhathaleli izwe. "URamaphosa usitshela ukuthi imibono yabantu ngeke bayilalele ngoba sebezokwenza intando yabo beyi-ANC. Sizolwisana nale mizamo yabo yokuwisa umnotho wethu nokuthi umhlaba ube sezandleni zikahulumeni okhohlakele," kusho uMaimane. USotshwebhu we-IFP ePhalamende, uMnuz Narend Singh uthe abahambisani nokuthathwa komhlaba ngaphandle kwesinxephezelo ngoba lokhu kusho ukuthi abantu bazogcina sebehlala emijondolo ngoba uhulumeni ukhohlakele.

Kuleli sonto kuvele ukuthi ukuthengwa kwalokhu kudla okusuke sekuphekiwe njengopholoni, amasosishi, amaviyena nokunye, kwehle ngo-75%, kwathi ukuthengwa kwemikhiqizo yenyama yengulube kwehla ngo-50%, okuyinto eseyenze ukuthi izinkampani ezidayisa lokhu kudla zehlelwe yinzuzo ngo-40%. Uthe nabantu abazizamela ngokudayisa ukudla, okubalwa amagwinya nokunye okusheshayo njengamasosishi, bashayeke kakhulu ngenxa yale nkinga. URamaphosa uthe umbiko awuthole kwiSouth African Meat Processing Association, okuyiyo esekhaleni lokubheka konke okwenzekayo kule mboni selokhu kwaqubuka lesi sifo, ukhomba nokuthi izinkampani ezithintekayo ezikhiqiza lolu hlobo lokudla, zidla ngamapayipi nakwezezimali. Yize kulo masipala kuvela ukuthi wenza kahle ekubhalisweni kweziguli, uNkk Maseko uveze ukuthi isibhedlela sidala futhi ingqalasizinda yaso isigugile kanti sithola iziguli eziningi ezivela kwabanye omasipala eziza kuso ngenxa yokuthi kulula ukufinyelela kuso uma usebenzisa ezokuthutha zomphakathi. “Isibhedlela sakhiwa ngo-1938, ukukhula kwesibalo seziguli ezihambela kuso kwenza ukuthi sisebenze kanzima ngoba ingqalasizinda yethu incane, ikhemisi lethu lincane, indawo yokwamukela iziguli incane, indawo esilahla kuyo udoti incane. KUBHUNTSHE umngcwabo abamakhaza begoloza nesidumbu befuna imali okuthiwa bebengavumelananga ngayo nomndeni kamufi.Umndeni wakwaMohlakwana eMzongwane, eMatatiele, ukhala ezimathonsi ngezindleko othi ufakwe kuzo yinkampani yabangcwabi iHambakahle Funeral Parlour ekwaV eMlaza, kulandela ukunqaba nesidumbu sikaNksz Buhle Mohlakwana (35) okuthiwa ushonele esibhedlela iKing George eThekwini ngesonto eledlule.Isidumbu bekulindeleke ukuthi sifike eMatatiele ngoLwesihlanu. Kuthiwa bese kwenziwe zonke izinhlelo zokuthi afihlwe ngoMgqibelo.UNkk Mavundle Khoza waseMatatiele ethintwa yiSolezwe uthe bezwe ubuhlungu obukhulu ngesikhathi bethintwa ngocingo wudadewabo kamufi uNksz Busisiwe Mohlakwana, ebazisa ukuthi abamakhaza abebeke kuwo udadewabo, bayanqaba nesidumbu.“Sihlale kwaze kwasa silindile ukuthi isidumbu kuzothiwa siyeza, hleze abamakhaza bashintshe umqondo kodwa lutho. Omakhelwane abebezosikhalisa kudingeke ukuthi babuyele emakhaya. Sifile ngezindleko esingene kuzo kulungiselelwa umngcwabo ebesazi ukuthi uzoba ngoMgqibelo,” kusho uNkk Khoza.UNksz Mohlakwana uthe usola ambize ngomnikazi wenkampani yabangcwabi uMnuz Ndabezinhle Manzi ngokubalutha ethi uzobagcinela isidumbu emakhazeni ngemali encane okuthe uma sebesayinile washayela ucingo amalungu omndeni wafuna imali enkulu.“Ngesikhathi ngithola ucingo lokuthi udadewethu ushonile, ngiphuthume esibhedlela. Osebenza emakhazeni kahulumeni othe ungowakwaKhanyile, usitshele ukuthi kubiza kakhulu ukugcina umuntu emakhazeni kahulumeni ngakho kungakuhle sithole awethu amakhaza lapha sizomgcina khona,” kusho uNksz Mohlakwana.Uthe bacele umsebenzi ukuthi abaxhumanise nenkampani yabangcwabi engabasiza njengoba bengenayo imali eyisamba yokukhokhela amakhaza, wabe esebaxhumanisa noManzi.Uthe ufike kubo wathembisa ukuthi uzobenzela konke bese bona bemkhokhela imali abanayo ngohlelo lwesitolimende.Uveze ukuthi bavumelane ngoR11 000 kuhlanganisa ibhokisi nemali yokuhambisa isidumbu eMatatiele.“Sekumele kuthathwe isidumbu, uManzi ufune uR17 000, wasinqabela nokuthi sibone isidumbu ethi sikhona emakhazeni kodwa sizosibona uma sesikhokhile.”Kuthintwa uManzi, uthe umndeni yiwona ozikhethele uhlobo lokungcwaba olubiza uR17 000.“Bakhethe ibhokisi oluwuhlobo olubizayo ngoba udadewabo kamufi ubethenjiswe abaqashi bakhe ukuthi bazomnika imali enguR10 000. Uthe omunye uR10 000 uzowuthola kusonhlalakahle obelandela udaba lokugula kukamufi,” kusho uManzi.Ukhale ngezindleko athe ungene kuzo eya ezihlotsheni zikamufi, ehla enyuka ngemoto yomsebenzi eyobanxusa ukuthi bakhokhe ngenxa yokuthi bebengasamthinti kwaze kwaphela izinsuku ezintathu kungaxhunyanwa.Emuva kokungenelela kweSolezwe namaphoyisa asesiteshini saseMlaza umndeni ogcine ubike kuwo, uManzi uthe bavumelene nomndeni ngokuthi isidumbu uzosihambisa namuhla.UNksz Mohlokwana ukuqinisekisile ukuthi bavumelene noManzi, ngokukhokha imali enguR7 500.Uthe babikele amaphoyisa aseMlaza agcine esebaphelezela ukuyoxoxa noManzi.

UMVIKELI woMphakathi u-Advocate Busisiwe Mkhwebane uthe bazohlangana enkantolo noMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa ngodaba lomnikelo awuthola enkampanini iBosasa njengoba elwenze ngendlela uphenyo lwakhe. "Nginabo bonke ubufakazi ngalolu daba sizoveza yonke into enkantolo. Udaba ngiludlulisele ophikweni lwezokushushisa ukuze kube yilona oluzophenya udaba lwalo mnikelo nokuthi kwabakhona ukushushumbiswa kwemali," kusho u-Advocate Mkhwebane. UJABULELA ukushintsha kwempilo yakhe owesifazane waseShowe obenenkinga yesisu esikhulu nokukhuluphala ngokweqile, ohlinzwe mahhala ngabakwaNetcare.UNksz Khanyiswa Thusi (36) obeseshaya isisindo esingu-180kg, utshele Isolezwe ukuthi ubesezame zonke izindlela zokunciphisa isisu kodwa kungalungi. Wabhalela abakwaNetcare ngoDisemba 16 wonyaka odlule ecela usizo. Isikhalo sakhe safinyelelwa kuDkt Gert Du Toit wesibhedlela iNetcare St Augustine’s eThekwini, osebenza ophikweni iMetabolic Centre. UDkt Du Toit wacela nosizo kwiNetcare Foundation ukulekelela ngezindleko zokuhlinzwa.UNksz Thusi uhlinzwe ngoNovemba 27 emuva kwezinyanga ezimbalwa, ebonana nodokotela abahlukene nongoti bendlela yokudla. Uthe ubesephenduke inhlekisa ngobukhulu bakhe, esehlala egula.“Akukho engingakuzamanga ngizama ukunciphisa isisu, ngizame ngisho ijimu nokushintsha indlela yokudla. Bengingasakwazi nokulima kahle njengoba ngiziphilisa ngakho. Mkhulu umehluko engiwuzwayo emzimbeni wami, ngizizwa ngilula. Sekukhona ukudla engingasakwazi ukukudla, okuvele kubuye uma ngikuphoqa,” echaza.Uthe odokoteka bathe kuzothatha isikhathi esingangonyaka ukuze anciphe ngokuphelele.UDkt Du Toit uthe emuva kwesonto uNksz Thusi ehlinziwe ubesehle ngo-15 kg emzimbeni. Uthe ngaphambi kokuhlinzwa wancipha ngo-7kg.“Silindele ukuthi agcine eshaya isisindo sika-70kg, okuzosiza nokuthi angahlaselwa izifo. Sikujabulele ukwenza ushintsho empilweni kaNksz Thusi futhi usinike isizathu esibalulekile sokubuyisela emphakathini. Siyathemba ukuthi uzolulama ngokuphelele, aqhubeke nomsebenzi wakhe,” kusho uDkt Du Toit.UNkk Mande Toubkin oyiGeneral Manager kwaEmergency, Trauma, Transplant and Corporate Social Investment kwaNetcare uthe bathinteka ngokubona isimo sikaNksz Thusi, bazibophezela ukuthi bamkhokhele zonke izindleko.UNksz Thusi uthe utshelwe ukuthi ukuhlinzwa kukodwa kubiza uR250 000. Leli phephandaba like labhala ngoNksz Thusi nonyaka, ngomsebenzi wakhe wokulima nokutshala amaButternut. Uthe kumanje usedayisela isitolo sakwaSpar eShowe kodwa usafisa ukufaka nakwezinye.

Ikomiti elibhekene nezindaba nokuhlelwa kwazo ngaphansi kwebhodi lakwaSABC, izolo likhiphe isitatimende livuma ukuthi yile nhlangano eyaphula imithetho yayo ngale ngxoxo kaNksz Dlamini esisuse umsindo, eyasakazwa ngoDisemba 7 no-8. Leli komiti beliziphendulela ngemuva kokugxekwa wumphakathi kulandela ukuputshuka kwezindaba zokuthi uMnyango wezokuThuthukiswa koMphakathi wakhokhela iSABC imali engu-R149 000 ukuze kukhishelwe eshashalazini uNksz Dlamini kwiReal Talk with Anele. Umnyango wavuma ukukhokhela iSABC uR149 000 ngokuba nengxoxo, okuyisamba esingadalulwanga emphakathini. Okhulumela iSABC, uMnuz Kaizer Kganyago uthe akukho zinyathelo ezizothathelwa umuntu ngoba le nhlangano itholile ukuthi yiyona eyaba nephutha. "Ibhodi lenelisekile ukuthi leli phutha lalingahlosiwe. Sasuke sagxila ekutheni le ngxoxo yayiwudaba kodwa sakhohlwa ukulandela eminye imigomo yakwaSABC. Ngenxa yalokho akukho muntu ozojeziswa," kuphendula uKganyago. Uthe umnyango wawungeke uthunyelelwe yi-SABC i-invoice ngale ngxoxo. Uthe lihlanganile ibhodi ladingida kabanzi ngale nkokhelo. I-SABC ithe ayilandelanga inqubomgomo yayo ngaphambi kokuthatha isinqumo sokusakaza lezi ziqephu. Lolu daba lususe umsindo nasezinkundleni zokuxhumana kangangoba * -Anele ube manaphanapha yinhlamba esolwa ngokugwazelwa ngoR500 000 ukuze akhulume noNksz Dlamini kulolu hlelo. Eziphendulela * -Anele kwiTwitter, uthe yena umsulwa ngoba iSABC egunyaza ukuba kusakazwe uhlelo. "Yibo abanezwi eliphelele ohlelweni. Mina ngiholelwa yiSABC. Umnyango uxhumana neSABC. Ophrojusa bathatha izinqumo bese mina ngenza ucwaningo ngisakaze uhlelo. Ngiyacela ukhulume neSABC hhayi mina umuntu odumile odabeni," kusho * -Anele. Kuthe kusenjalo nomrepha uKwesta wabhuqa * -Anele kwiTwitter ngokubhala ukuthi ‘Oh yingakho sivalelwa ngaphandle.’ Ubuye esevutha bhe * -Anele esola uKwesta ngokuba namanga, wathi bese kuyihlandla lesine bemmema kulolu hlelo kodwa engalubhadi. Ugcine exolisile uKwesta ku-Anele nasethimbeni asebenzisana nalo. Lesi sitatimende seSABC sithe * -Anele nethimba lakhe babelandela imiyalelo. Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi leli phutha ngeke liphinde lenzeke, iSABC izibophezele ukuthi isizolandela inqubomgomo yayo futhi ishicilele nemisha ezoyibeka ukuze wonke umsebenzi wakwaSABC angazitholi eseyiphula engazi. "Iziphathimandla zizokwazisa iGCIS ukuthi iSABC ngeke iyithumele i-invoice yokukhokhelwa uR149, 000, okuyimali obekufanele kukhishelwe ngayo le nkulumo ngxoxo." AMANYE amakhosi awafuni nakuyizwa indaba yeNgonyama Trust njengoba ethi afuna ukuziphathela wona umhlaba wawo, azilawule nemali eyenziwa ngawo. Inkosi Mzabane Makhoba yaseKokstad eNingizimu yeKwaZulu-Natal ithe yize yabekwa yiSilo uGoodwill Zwelithini kaBhekuzulu futhi iyawuncoma umsebenzi owenziwa Ingonyama Trust evikela umhlaba wamakhosi ukuthi uthathwe wuhulumeni kodwa amakhosi kufanele aziphathele umhlaba wawo. "INgonyama Trust kufanele inike amakhosi ilungelo lokuthi aziphathele imali ekhokhwa abatshalizimali abasuke besebenzisa umhlaba. Njengamanje yonke imali eyenziwa emhlabeni wamakhosi iya kwiNgonyama Trust. Amakhosi nezizwe zawo awahlomuli ngalutho," kusho uMakhoba. Uthe amakhosi kufanele aziphathele wona umhlaba wawo nemali eyenziwa kuwona ukuze kuzohlomula izizwe zawo. KwaZulu-Natal angu-303 amakhosi ahambisana nokuthi umhlaba wawo uphathwe iNgonyama Trust futhi awafuni ukuthi uhulumeni asondele kulo mhlaba. INgonyama Trust iphethwe yiSilo, inomhlaba ongu-2.8 million hectares okungumhlaba wasemakhaya omningi kanti ngonyaka iqoqa uR90 million kosomabhizinisi abasebenzisa lo mhlaba. Inkosi Bhungane Hadebe ithe isizwe sayo esise-Estcourt asiyazi iNgonyama Trust ngoba asikaze sithintwe ngesikhathi isungulwa. "Sihambisana neSilo ekutheni umhlaba ngowamakhosi akusiwo okahulumeni kodwa asihambisana neNgonyama Trust ngoba yasungulwa ngaphandle kokwazisa amakhosi," kusho uHadebe. Umholi we-IFP, Inkosi Mangosuthu Buthelezi ngokubambisana nohulumeni kaMengameli owayephethe ngaleso sikhathi uMnuz FW de Klerk, yasungula Ingonyama Trust ngo-1994. Nesonto eledlule uButhelezi uthe wasungula iNgonyama Trust ukuvikela umhlaba wabantu basemakhaya. Enye inkosi ecele ukungadalulwa ithe iSilo asinawo umhlaba ngoba ngowokhokho bamakhosi abawudlulisela kwizizukulwane zabo. Asihambisani nokuthi umhlaba wethu uphathwe Ingonyama sifuna ukuziphathela wona njengoba sasiwuphethe kudala," kusho le nkosi. Enye inkosi ikhale ngokuthi kudala ibizithathela izinqumo ngomhlaba wayo kodwa manje sekufanele ibhalele Ingonyama ngaphambi kokusebenzisa umhlaba wayo. Inkosi Nhlakanipho Maphumulo enguNobhala weCongress of Traditional Leaders of South Africa (Contralesa) ithe wonke amakhosi anelungelo lokuphatha umhlaba wawo kodwa abatshalizimali okufanele basayine isivumelwano sokusebenzisa umhlaba neNgonyama Trust. "Osomabhizinisi bakhokha irenti yokusebenzisa umhlaba kwiNgonyama Trust. Kunama-akhawunti aveza ukuthi umhlaba wenkosi ethile wenza malini," kusho uMaphumulo. UMntwana uThulani Zulu okhulumela Isilo walile ukuphawula. UJaji Jerome Ngwenya onguSihlalo weNgonyama Trust Board akawaphendulanga ama-sms nama-emails athunyelelwe wona ngesonto eledlule. Iphephandaba iMail&Guradian libike ukuthi iNgonyama Trust iyiswe enkantolo ngabantu abafuna iyeke ukukhokhisa amasonto, osomabhizinisi nabanye abantu abasebenzisa umhlaba wamakhosi. KwaZulu-Natal ibandla lamaLuthela libalwa nezinhlangano ezihambise Ingonyama Trust enkantolo ngoba likhala ngokuthi abantu bazolahlekelwa wumhlaba uma behluleka wukukhokhela umhlaba. Uveze ukuthi waya emahhovisi omnyango ngoJanuwari 12 wonyaka odlule, wagcwalisa ifomu okuthiwa izosiza ukuthi abuyiselwe emagameni abaphilayo. Umufi wayefunda ophikweni lwaseSteve Biko, eThekwini ngoSepthemba 9, lapho ashaywa khona ekhanda ngesando ngaphambi kokuthi abanjwe inkunzi.Likhipha isigwebo, iJaji uKhosi Hadebe, lithe akusaphephile kunoma yisiphi isikhungo semfundo “kusuka esikoleni samabanga aphansi kuze kufike emanyuvesi”.Ekhuluma ngaphandle kwenkantolo sekukhishwe isigwebo, uyise kamufi, uMnuz Sibusiso Ndhlovu (45) uthe bachitha izinsuku ezingu-10 eceleni kombhede kaSandile e-ICU bethandazela isimangaliso.“Satshelwa ngoSepthemba 10, ukuthi ingqondo yakhe ngeke isaphinde isebenze futhi salulekwa ukuba simkhiphe emishinini emgcine ephila. Sacela isikhathi esengeziwe futhi sathandazela ukuthi alulame ekulimaleni ekhanda. Ngangingakholwa ukuthi ukuphela kwengane esasinayo ayisekho. Manje ngibona sengathi akukho okungikhuthaza ukuthi ngiye emsebenzini ngoba ngisebenze kanzima ukuqinisekisa ikusasa eliqhakazile kuye,” kusho uNdhlovu.Into eyayinzima kakhulu kuye kwakuyilapho indodana yakhe ingasabizwa ngegama layo kodwa ikhonjwa ngenombolo, idluliswa isuka kwamanye amakhaza iyiswa kwamanye.“Usuku lo mame, usuku lobaba noKhisimusi ngeke kusaphinde kufane ngaphandle kwakhe.”Lo mndeni, odabuka eMpumalanga, kaweneme ngalesi sigwebo, ngoba uthi ngeke siyibuyise indodana. Yize kunjalo kodwa ukhululekile ngokuthi icala lifinyelele emaphethelweni.UMbutho, odabuka eClermont, obephume ngoshwele ejele ngamacala okugqekeza izindlu ngo-2014, waya eDUT wahlasela umufi kabili ngesando weba iselula yakhe ne-laptop.Inkantolo izwe ukuthi wake waba ngumfundi oqavile, owaqeda * -matric ngamalengiso, waya eDUT ukuyokwenza izifundo zeSocial Science kodwa wazishiya ngemuva kokuba sengozini yemoto lapho aphuka imilenze yomibili. Walulama ngokuphelele, yilapho-ke aqala khona ubugebenguNgeledlule uMbutho uvume icala lokubulala uSandile. Encwadini yokuvuma icala, efundwe ngummeli wakhe * -Irshad Khan, uMbutho uthe waya eDUT eyontshontsha “noma yiziphi izinto ezikhala kahle”.“Ngikwenze lokhu ngenxa yokuphelelwa yithemba ngoba ngingasebenzi, ngingenamali futhi ngingenamathemba omsebenzi ongangingenisela imali,” kusho incwadi yakhe.UKhan ucele inkantolo icubungule isimo sikaMbutho, ibheke ukushonelwa uyise esafunda kanti unina washona ngonyaka wakhe wokuqala efunda eDUT.Ummeli woMbuso, uMnuz Bonginkosi Mbokazi, ukuchithile lokhu wathi uMbutho wanikezwa ithuba lesibili empilweni ngenkathi enikwa ushwele emuva kokugwetshwa ngaphambilini.“Uneminyaka engu-29, ufundile futhi uhlakaniphile. Kwakufanele azi kangcono.Irekhodi lakhe lezemfundo likhombisa ukuthi uhlakaniphile ngokwanele ukuthi azi ukuthi lokho akwenzile bekungalungile.”Uthe isenzo sikaMbutho asithetheleki futhi akekho umzali okufanele adlule kulokhu abazali bakaSandile abadlule kukho.UMnuz Alan Khan, okhulumela iDUT, uthe bakhululekile ukuthi ubulungiswa benziwe nokuthi uMbutho utholwe enecala lokuhlasela okunobudlova ngakwenza kuSandile.“Yize sazi ukuthi lokhu ngeke kumbuyise uSandile, siyethemba ukuthi umndeni wakhe, abangani nalabo abefunda nabo bazoduduzwa wulwazi lokuthi umsolwa ubanjiwe, wagwetshwa ngempumelelo futhi wagwetshwa ngokufanele ngokuhlasela okunonya. Sengathi umphefumulo kaSandile ungaphumula ngokuthula,” kusho uKhan.

UBrown utshele ikhomishini yeJaji Raymond Zondo izolo ukuthi uZwane wacela umhlangano nezikhulu zakwaNedbank ukuze kuxoxwe ngodaba lokuhlengwa kwemisebenzi yabantu baseNingizimu Afrika ngoMeyi ka-2016. Uthe ngesikhathi uZwane eqala umhlangano wathi amanye amabhange anqabile ukuhlangana nekomiti longqongqoshe waphinde wasabisa ngokuthi ikomiti linamandla amakhulu zakwaNedbank. "Ngamtshela uZwane ukuthi ngeke sikhulume ngezindaba zamakhasimende ebhange kodwa yena wayelokhu efuna ukukhuluma ngodaba lwabantu bakwaGupta. Wasicela ukuthi sisebenzisane nabakwaGupta emuva kokuthi amanye amabhange evale ama-akhawunti amabhizinisi abo. Yize sasitshelwe ukuthi sizohlangana nongqongqoshe abahlukene kodwa sagcina sesibonana noZwane kuphela," kusho uBrown. Uthe bavala ama-akhawunti omndeni wakwaGupta nezinkampani zawo, okubalwa kuzo i-Oakbay Investments, Islandsite, Confident Concept, Sahara Computers neVR Lazer emuva kokusola ukuthi kukhona okushaya amanzi. "Sahlangana ngo-Ephreli 6 siyikomiti lasebhange eNedbank, sasifunde imibiko yokuthi iFNB ne-Absa isiwavalile ama-akhawunti akwaGupta. Sabona ukuthi sisengozini uma singawavali ngoba sasibonile ukuthi kukhona okushaya amanzi kuwo. Sinelungelo lokuqeda ubudlelwane bethu nezaphula mthetho," kusho uBrown. Uthe banikeza abakwaGupta izinsuku eziwu-30 bebazisa ukuthi bazovala ama-akhawunti abo. Njengoba izikhulu zakwamanye amabhange ziveze ukuthi zabizwa emhlanganweni oseLuthuli House, uBrown uthe neNedbank nayo yabizelwa kulo mhlangano. "Kwakukhona owayenguNobhala Jikelele we-ANC, uMnuz Gwede Mantashe, uNkk Jessie Duarte, owayeyiPhini lakhe noMnuz Enock Godogwana, obhekelele ezomnotho kwi-ANC. Abazange basisabise kodwa bathi bafuna ukuqonda ukuthi kungani amabhange ekhethe ukuvala ama-akhawunti omndeni wakwaGupta nokuthi lesi sinyathelo sizoba namthelela muni kubatshalizimali," kusho uBrown. Uthe bachazela amalungu e-ANC ngemithetho yokusebenza kwamabhange nomthelela oba khona uma kunabaphula imithetho yezezimali. Ibhange i-Absa lithi lona lasatshiswa ngokuthi izonqanyulwa inkontileka yalo uma liqhubeka nokuvala ama-akhawunti womndeni wakwaGupta.

IZAZI zomnotho zigqugquzela abantu ukuthi babophe izifociya futhi bamukele ukuthi intengo kaphethroli izolokhu yehla yenyuka, ngendlela okwenzeka ngayo ngoba uhulumeni akakezi namasu okwehlisa intela kaphethroli. UMnuz Doctor Sangweni oyisazi somnotho enkampanini iDolsden Oracle, uthe uphethroli othengwa kwamanye amazwe uthengwa ngentengo ebekwe ngamazwe awukhiqizayo bese uma ufika kuleli ufakwe intela ehlukene okungekaphethroli nesiza abalimele ezingozini zomgwaqo. Uthe uhulumeni nokuntenga kwerandi kwenza iNingizimu Afrika iwuthenge ngemali eningi uphethroli. "Uhulumeni nguye olawula intengo kaphethroli ngokuthi uma usufike kuleli afake intela. Mhlawumbe ukube intela iyehliswa bese amagaragi eze nentengo yawo yamalitha ngabe kunokuncintisana phakathi kwawo. Akufanele intela imbe eqolo ngoba yilokho okwenza ilitha likaphethroli limbe eqolo," kusho uSangweni. Mayelana nodaba lokuthi iNingizimu Afrika ikhiqiza uphethroli wayo wakwaSasol, umcwaningi wezomnotho, uMnuz Sakhile Dlamini uvumile ukuthi ukhona uphethroli okhiqizwa eNingizimu Afrika osuselwa emalahleni. "Kuyimanje iSasol ihamba phambili ezinkampanini ezikhiqiza uphethroli osuselwa emalahleni emhlabeni jikelele. Lo phethroli ubizwa nge-synthetic fuel futhi kudala waqala ukwenziwa kuleli, ngesikhathi uhulumeni wobandlululo evalwa ukuthi athenge uwoyela emazweni angaphandle. Ube esesungula iSasol okuyiyona ekhiqiza iSasol fuel eminyakeni engu-63 edlule," kusho uDlamini. Uthe lolu hlobo lukaphethroli lwaqala ukwenziwa eGermany ngabo-1920 futhi uyasetshenziswa emazweni amaningi. UDlamini ucele abantu ukuthi babophe izifociya bathenge lokho okuyizidingo ngoba azikakenziwa izinhlelo zokwehlisa intela kaphethroli eNingizimu Afrika.

Unina walo mfundi, esingeke simdalule ukuze kuvikelwe isithunzi somfundi, uthe usefisa nokuyikhipha ingane esikoleni ngoba iphoxekile kakhulu. Lo wesifazane ubethukuthele eveva ethi impilo yengane yakhe isengcupheni uma kunezigameko ezinje esikoleni. "Alukho usizo esiluthola esikoleni ngoba lezi zingane zikhonjiwe ziyaziwa, kufanele ngabe kubizwa abazali bazo zijeziswe kodwa akwenziwanga lokho." Kuthiwa kunamabhoklolo aphuca izingane imiphako yazo kodwa akukho okwenziwayo ngalokho. Inhliziyo yami ibuhlungu, ukube akuwona uJuni ngabe ngiyayikhipha ingane yami kulesi sikole,"' kubalisa unina wengane. Uthe indodana yakhe iyile kudokotela wayihlola, wathola ukuthi awukho umonakalo otheni. Unina wengane ukhathazeke ngokuthi kungenzeka umonakalo uvele emuva kwesikhathi eside isindala ingane. Okhulumela uMnyango wezeMfundo KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Kwazi Mthethwa, uthe inkinga yezingane eziqonela ezinye ezikoleni idlongile. Ukhale ngokuthi izimpande zayo zisemuva emakhaya lapho izingane zingafundiswa khona ngendlela. "Esimweni esinjalo siyaphenya bese sijezisa lowo mfundi osuke etholakale enecala ngoba ngeke kubekezelelwe ububhoklolo. Yinto embi kabi ukuthi kube nomfundi ohlukunyezwa adonswe ngomphambili esikoleni,"' kusho uMthethwa. Unina wengane uthe usebuya ngisho kosonhlalakahle ngoba ubonile ukuthi ingane yakhe yethuka izanya, iyesaba ukuya esikoleni ngoba iphenduke inhlekisa ezinganeni efunda nazo. Uthe okumcika kakhulu ukuthi kuthalalisiwe esikoleni sengathi akwenzekanga lutho.

BAYAVEVA abenhlangano elwela abathandana nobulili obufanayo ngezinsolo zokuthi amaphoyisa ashaye abesilisa ababili, bavalelwa esiteshini ngoba becwaswa ngobulili. UMnuz Vincent Nkosi (24) waseChesterville ongumfundi eRegent Business School eThekwini, uthi usahlukumezekile ngenxa yalesi sigameko esenzeke ngoLwesine olwedlule ngasebhishi eThekwini. Wayehamba nomngani wakhe wasePitoli uKgotatso obevakashile ngamaholidi eThekwini. Elandisa ngokwenzeka, uNkosi uthe babezihambela ngasebhishi ngesikhathi kuqhamuka amadoda amabili eza kubona sekukhona akukhipha emaphaketheni. "Indawo esasihamba kuyo ayiphephile, yingakho sacabanga ukuthi yizigebengu ezizosibamba inkunzi. Sabaleka ngokuhlukana nomngani wami, omunye wesilisa weza kimina wazibiza ngephoyisa. Wakhipha isibhamu wabuza ukuthi ngibalekelani engibiza ngesitabane, wangidonsa ngebhande lebhulukwe wangishaya. Wangilalisa phansi emgwaqweni esaqhubeka nokungithuka." Uthe wabona lona omunye wesilisa esebuya nomngani wakhe embambe ngesidlozana, bobabili bafakwa evenini yamaphoyisa. Uthe bahanjiswe esiteshini samaphoyisa esingumahambanendlwana esisebhishi. "Safica kukhona owesifazane osekhulile kuleli gumbi, bamtshela ukuthi akaphume ukuze basiqondise kahle. Umngani wami unezwi elincane njengowesifazane, bekuthi uma ekhuluma bamthethise bathi akakhulume njengendoda. Umngani wami ucele nokushayela unina ucingo, banqaba bathi nguyena omvumele ukuthi abe yisitabane. Bebelokhu bengishaya ngezimpama, bangibuza nangeselula asesikhwameni sami bethi ngiyintshontshile," kuchaza uNkosi othe lawa maphoyisa abuza ukuthi ngesikabani isithombe sowesilisa esikwiselula yakhe, wabatshela ukuthi ngesomuntu athandana naye. "Bathi bazongibophela kwakona lokho ukuthi indoda yami ngiyibhangqile ngoba ngihamba nenye indoda. Kwale noma ngibatshela ukuthi uphathina wami uyazi ukuthi ngihamba nomngani wami," kusho uNkosi. Uthe umngani wakhe udedelwe kuqala esiteshini, yena babuye bamdedela kamumva. Bavule icala lokushaywa nelokucwaswa esiteshini samaphoyisa ePhoyinti. Okhulumela iDurban Lesbian and Gay Community and Health Care uMnuz Sbo Khumalo uthe: "Kuyasidumaza ukuthi sigubha inyanga yenkululeko kodwa kusekhona abantu abangawahloniphi amalungelo abanye. Okusithusa kakhulu ukuthi kuthinteka abantu abazi umthetho. Sizolulandela lolu daba futhi sizocela izeluleko kwikhomishini yamalungelo abantu nakwikhomishini yezokulingana ngobulili ngoba sifuna ubulungiswa," kushou Khumalo. Okhulumela amaphoyisa esifundazweni uLieutenant Colonel Thulani Zwane uthe kuphenywa icala lokushaya emuva kokuba abesilisa ababili behlaselwa abasolwa ababafaka evenini yamaphoyisa kodwa ababengawugqokile umfaniswano womsebenzi.

Uyise womfana (igama lakhe elingeke lidalulwe ukuvikelwe umfana) uthi uthuke kwaphela nasozwaneni ngesikhathi ehla esitobhini ntambama ngoLwesithathu ephuma emsebenzini, elinye ilungu lomphakathi limcela ukuba behlisane baye emzini ongumakhelwane lapho kugcinwe khona indodana yakhe okuthiwa ibanjwe kulo muzi igibele imfene, ekuseni ngabo 9. Uthe ngesikhathi esondela, ugxavunwe kabuhlungu ngamanye amalungu omphakathi abesola yena nonina (uninakhulu womfana) ngokusebenzisa ingane ezenzweni zokuthakatha. "Ngisindele abebengikhuzela ngenkathi abafana bakulo muzi besho ukungiqeda. Kuze kwafika amaphoyisa okuyiwona agcine ekhulume nesixuku ebesingezwa mshini," kusho yena. Uthi utshelwe ukuthi indodana yakhe ibanjwe bukhoma kulo muzi igibele imfene, imfene yabaleka yangena ehlathini. Uthi amalungu omphakathi abesho ukungena kulo muzi efuna imfene okuthiwa ifuywe nguninakhulu womfana. "Vele lo mndeni okuthiwa indodana yami beyithakatha kuwona, asizwani kahle," kuqhuba uyise womfana. Uthe sebethuka izanya besaba ukuthi bangase bahlaselwe. Uthe namuhla uya enkantolo ukuyofaka isicelo sencwadi yokuvikelwa komakhelwane. NJENGOBA uJuni uhlonzwa njengenyanga yentsha, sekuvele izibalo ezishaqisayo zentsha yaseNingizimu Afrika yesilisa emnyama okuthiwa iqengqeleza phambili ngokucwila ezinkambeni zikaFaro. Ngo-1976 intsha yakuleli yayilwa namaBhunu ifuna ukuqedwa kokufunda ngesibhunu zonke izifundo, kodwa eyanamuhla enye yayo ingene shi kwizidakamizwa. Ucwaningo olwenziwe ngabomkhankaso oqwashisa ngokucwila otshwalweni i-Aware Organisation. Lolu cwaningo luveza isithombe sokuthi lapha eNingizimu Afrika kuthengwa utshwala buka-R3.8 billion ngonyaka. Kubantu bakuleli balinganiselwa ku-60% abaphuza utshwala kanti kubona bangu-34% abaphuza ngokweqile. Kulesi sibalo isilinganiso sekota ngabesilisa abamnyama abaneminyaka eqala ku-24 kuya ku-35 abazithola becwile kubona ngendlela exakile. Ucwaningo luveza ukuthi iningi lentsha yakuleli kuthi ineminyaka engu-12 isuke isilingeka ifise ukuzwa ukuthi utshwala bunambitheka kanjani. Enye iyadikila ingaphide ibuthinte ngenxa yokungathatheki kodwa enye iyabuyela kubona igcine isibujwayele. Ngeshwa enye iyedlulela igcine isiyimulutha yotshwala. Le ntsha isuke inezizathu ezahlukene ezisuke siyiholele kulo mbulalazwe. Phakathi kwezizathu ezibaliwe ezidoba intsha wukuthi iningi layo isuke isiphothule isikole, isanda kuqala umsebenzi futhi isizithathela izinqumo ngemali yayo. Kulapho kwabanye kuqala kube nengcindezi yokufuna ukubukwa, ukudlisela kontanga nakwabobulili obehlukile. Enye intsha ibulawa amahloni, ukuze iwaqede isebenzisa utshwala bese bekwazi ukukhuluma babe nesibindi noma benze okuthile abasuke behlukela ukukwenza bengaphuzile. Ukuhlanganyela nabangani nemindeni emicimbini, nakho kuyabahlohla abanye ukuba bagcine bekhothakhothile kwezikaFaro ngenxa yokungafuni ukusala ezintweni. Inkinga iba lapho uma abanye sebephenduka izigqila zotshwala. Izinqumo nezibopho abanazo empilweni zigcine sezithikamezwa wukuphuza kakhulu. Utshwala obuningi emzimbeni womuntu kungadala ukuthi inhliziyo ime noma umuntu akhingcwe ngumphalazo wakhe ashone. Ukuphuza kakhulu kungagcina omunye umuntu esehanjelwa wumqondo nokungadala umonakalo emqondweni, omunye agule ngekhanda. Kwabesifazane abakhulelwe utshwala bulimaza ingane ibe nesifo iFetal Alcohol Syndrome esuke isakhula kuyena. Lokhu kulandela ukuthi umndeni namaphoyisa bedidekile ngokuthi kwenzekani ngesidumbu sikaNksz Makhosi Ndlangamandla (25) ngoba umphakathi uyamba lapho kuthiwa wagqitshwa khona kodwa akuveli lutho kuqhuma amanzi kuphela. UMnuz Sfiso Ndlangamandla, ongumfowabo kaNksz Ndlangamandla, uthe umfana eligodliwe igama lakhe, uyabalisa uthi le nto ayimniki ukuphumula ukhumbula konke okwenzeka. Uthe ingane kadadewabo eneminyaka engu-8 sebeyithathile bayoyifihla ngoba basaba ukuthi ingagcina isithola ukuthi unina wabulawa kanti basayifihlele. Uveze nokuthi besaba nokuthi uyise uma kwenzeka ephuma angayithatha. "Namanje asazi ukuthi yini lena amaphoyisa ewahlulayo ukuba athole iqiniso ngoba umfana uyazikhulumela. Ungichazelile nami ukuthi ubuthongo abusafiki. Lo mfana usekhuluma ngisho kubangani bakhe ngakho konke okwenzeka mhla kubulawa uMakhosi. Siphatheke kabi singumndeni ngoba kade sifika nomphakathi sizomba kodwa akuveli lutho, kunalokho kuqhuma amanzi," kusho uNdlangamandla. Uveze nokuthi amaphoyisa asebatshela ukuthi izinja zomkhondo ngeke bazithole ngoba lo muntu kade anyamalala. Uthe okubi wukuthi uyise womfana uthi akuhlukanwe nengane yakhe ngoba kuzolimala ikusasa layo. Amaphoyisa nawo athi abhekene nobunzima ngaleli cala. "Ngesikhathi umsolwa evuma ukuthi wayibulala intombazane saba nethemba lokuthi konke kuzoshesha. Kodwa osekuyinkinga wukuthi kuthe uma eseya enkantolo washaya ungqimphothwe esethi noma angabhekwa kodwa ngeke atholakale ngoba wamshisa. Uphinde athi icala lokudlwengula umzala wakhe oneminyaka engu-15 akalazi kodwa into angayikhuluma eyokubulala intombi yakhe. Sesivele sathatha isinqumo sokumvulela icala lokubulala," kusho iphoyisa elicele kugodlwe igama lalo. IMeya uMnuz Majuba Mavuso ebihambisana nomndeni beyobheka kule ndawo, ithe kuyabethusa ukuzwa ukuthi akucaci ngecala nokuthi amaphoyisa bezwa kuthiwa athi izinja ngeke zilethwe ngoba kade anyamalala uNksz Ndlangamandla. Uthe kuyiphutha lokho ngoba amaphoyisa ayakwazi ukuthola amathambo abantu abashona eminyakeni engaphezulu kuka-20 kodwa ayakhononda kumuntu onyamalale eminyakeni emithathu. Uthe kungcono udaba ludluliselwe emaphoyiseni asezingeni lesifundazwe. Abafundi baseMbambangwe Secondary abafunda u-matric badube amakilasi izolo nangoLwesithathu bekhala ngokuthi abasakwazi ukubekezelela ukushaywa nguthishanhloko, bakhala nangokuthi uyabathuka. Njengoba abafundi abaningi baka-matric bezoqhubeka nokufunda uma kuvalwa izikole namuhla, abaseMbambangwe abacele ukungadalulwa bathe abalubhadi esikoleni. Kuke kwavalwa amehlo ngesimo salesi sikole ngo-2014 kukhalwa ngabafundi abangalawuleki. Abanye babesolwa ngokuzihlanganisa namaqembu ezigebengu bese beqhubeka nezimpi zabo esikoleni. Ngo-2015 kwangenelela ikomidi iMbumbulu Education Forum ukulungisa isimo sesikole obesekuhlongozwa ukuthi sivalwe. USihlalo wekomiti inkosi Nathi Maphumulo, uthe bebengakezwa ngezinkinga zabafundi. Lesi yisifo esijwayele ukuhlasela asebekhulile, esenza balahlekelwe umqondo. UNksz Makhathini uthe wayengazi ukuthi unina unalesi sifo kodwa nasemndenini babecabanga ukuthi ukuguga. Ukusungula le nhlangano kuyingxenye yokuthi apholise amanxeba njengoba ethi ukushona kukanina kwashiya isilonda.Uchaze unina owayengunesi njengowesifazane obenesibindi, ebakhathalele nabantu. UNksz Makhathini washiya elakuleli waya ekudingisweni ngo-1981 ngenxa yezepolitiki. Uthe kwathatha isikhathi ukuthi unina amazi ukuthi ukuliphi izwe kodwa wamfuna waze wamthola, wamvakashela.“Ngaqala ngaya eTanzania ngesikhathi ngisuka eNingizimu Afrika, ngagcina sengiseSoviet Union. Yilapho engafike ngafundela iPsychology, namanje okuyiyona engisiza ukulekelela abaneDementia,” kusho yena.Yize uNksz Makhathini abuyela kuleli emuva kokhetho lwenkululeko ngo-1994, wanquma ukuyozinza e-England. Inhlangano ayisungulile iwaxhumanisa womabili lawa mazwe njengoba enehhovisi eLamontiville nelinye elise-England. Naye uyabuya ukuzobheka umsebenzi kuleli kodwa uxhumana nehhovisi nsuku zonke ngeSkype. Inhlangano wayisungula ngo-2015 emuva kokushona kukanina ngo-2012. Uveze ukuthi unina watholakala ukuthi unalesi sifo ngo-2009 kodwa ngalesi sikhathi lwalungekho usizo.“Baningi abaphethwe yilesi sifo kodwa kungaziwa. Umama watholakala nalesi sifo sesidlondlobele kakhulu yingakho ngisiza abantu ukuze basheshe bathole usizo,” kusho yena.Echaza ezinye izimpawu zaso uthe abanye bayakhohlwa noma bakhulume into engekho.“Kwakuthi uma ngihamba nomama ngemoto ngifuna angiyalele ngoba angilazi iTheku, acishe angiphonse ezimotweni engihambisa ngendlela okungeyona. Omunye kuyenzeka agcine ebiza ngisho amaphoyisa esola umndeni ngokuntshontshelwa imali ngoba esekhohliwe ukuthi uyifihlephi. Omunye ukhohlwa ngisho ukudla noma aphume imoto ihamba,” echaza.UNksz Makhathini osebenzisana nesibhedlela iKing Dinuzulu eThekwini ukusiza abanalesi sifo, uneSupport Group kanti ubuye asebenze ngocingo ukuhlolela iDementia.Ngaphandle kwalo msebenzi, usebenza nesikhungo iNational Health Service emkhakheni wePsycho Education e-England.

UKUSHODELWA yimali yokuthenga abaqwayizi kuholele ekutheni umfundisi osindisiwe adlwengule izingane zamantombazane ezingaphezu kuka-15, ezineminyaka esukela kwewu-3 kuya kwewu-12, emijondolo yaseLouisiana ePort Shepstone. Lezi zindaba zidalulwe wumndeni walo mfundisi, uThokozani Mvalelwa (34), ogwetshwe yiNkantolo yesiFunda yasePort Shepstone odilikajele abahlanu ngemuva kokuzivumela yena ukuthi ubedlwengula laba bantwana qede ababonge ngamaphakethe ama-chips noR2. Yize uMvalelwa, odabuka eLusikisiki, e-Eastern Cape, etshele inkantolo ukuthi zingaphezu kuka-15 izingane azidlwengula, kodwa kwafakaza ezinhlanu kuphela. Inkantolo ithole ukuthi lo mfundisi wadlwengula lezi zingane ezingomakhelwane phakathi kukaJuni no-Okthoba ka-2016. Imikhuba yalo mfundisi yavela ngesikhathi umzali wengane yentombazane eno-6, ethi uthuma indodakazi yakhe esitolo kanti izohlangana noMvalelwa, wayithatha wayiyisa endlini yakhe yomxhaso lapho ayidlwengulela khona maqede wayivala umlomo ngoR2. Ekhuluma neSolezwe ngoMgqibelo unina wale ntombazane, uthe wathi uma ezwa le mihlola wayobikela ikomiti. “Wafike wazivumela yena ukuthi wayidlwengula ingane yami futhi wathembisa ukuthi uzohlawula ngenkukhu. Waveza nokuthi ziningi izingane abezibiza bese elala nazo,” kusho lo mama elifihliwe igama lakhe ukuvikela ingane. Uthe izingane zonke zayiswa esibhedlela lapho odokotela bafike bakuqinisekisa ukuthi nebala zadlwengulwa. Ilungu leCommunity Policing Forum (CPF), uMnuz Simon Mthembu uthe babe sebebiza amaphoyisa ukuba ambophe uMvalelwa njengoba amanye amalungu omphakathi ayesefuna ukumudla amfele futhi efuna anqunyiswe okwembuzi. “Sathi uma simbuza ukuthi wayezidlwengulelani izingane ezincane kanje, wathi ubeswele imali yokuthenga abaqwayizi,” kusho uMthembu othi uMvalelwa ubaziwa njengekholwa ebelikhonze ukuzidumisela iNkosi kuphela. Le ndaba yaziwa ngisho nayizingane ezincane zaseLouisiana njengoba nasejoyintini lendawo isabhungwa. NoNksz Phumzile Khawula, oyisihlobo sikaMvalelwa, uthe naye wamtshela ukuthi usuke waphelelwa amatoho, wangabe esakwazi ukuthenga abaqwayizi. Eqhuba uNksz Khawula uthe uMvalelwa waqala wasonta eZayoni ngaphambi kokuyothwasa. “Indaba yonakala ngesikhathi esethi usindisiwe ngoba ubesenza nezinto ezingaqondakali. Wazivumela yena kimina ukuthi nonina wayemdlwengula njengoba egcine eshonile. Nezingane zezihlobo zakhe ubezidlwengula nje. Kukhona nje neyakithi ayidlwengula,” kusho uNksz Khawula. Umama (47) wengane eno-10 uthe wubulwane obenziwe nguMvalelwa ezinganeni zabo ngoba eziningi ziphazamisekile engqondweni futhi azisenzi kahle ezifundweni zazo esikoleni sendawo iLouisiana Primary. UMnuz Thozamile Zomba, obengumakhelwane kaMvalelwa, uthe naye waqala wangakholwa esezwa ukuthi uMvalelwa wenze la manyala. “Ngahluleka ngisho esezivumela yena kodwa ngangingakholwa. Uze wagwetshwa nje ngingakholwa ngoba ubewumntwana ohloniphayo obekhonze ukusonta. Ubungaze umfake nasekhukhwini. Ubehlale engungwe yizingane, kungasoli muntu,” kusho uZomba. Onina bezingane bathe nakuba benelesekile yisigwebo kodwa okwenziwa wuMvalelwa ezinganeni zabo kuyisihluku esingefaniswe.

KUPHELA ngisho ubungani kwabesifazabe uma kubangwa indoda, bagcina sebelwa bodwa. Akujwayelekile ukuthi uma abesifazane sebethole ukuthi indoda ibabhangqile balwe nayo kodwa baklwebhana bodwa. Lo mkhuba kade waqala njengoba nasezikoleni bekunomkhuba odume ngokuthi ipero, lapho abesifazane babelindana sekuphume isikole belwela ukuthi bajola nomfana oyedwa. Yize nabesilisa belwa bebanga intombi, uNksz Zola Dudeni oyiPsychologist uthi abafana kuyenzeka badlulise uma bebanga intombi kusajolwa nje. Kwehlukile lokhu kwabesifazane athe ngisho bekade bengabangani uma kuke kwabangwa indoda kuphela konke. Uthe yindlela abadalwe ngayo abesifazane eyenza ukuthi bebodwa bangasekani futhi bangaziboni bebalulekile. Uthe isikhathi esiningi abakwenzayo ukujabulisa owesilisa abazi ukuthi yilona joka abanalo. "Owesifazane wadalelwa ukujabulisa owesilisa ngoba ngisho intombazane ingakwazi ukwenza imisebenzi yasendlini, abadala bayibuza ukuthi iyokwenzenjani endodeni. Lokhu kwenza owesifazane akhule azi ukuthi kumele ajabulise indoda kukho konke akwenzayo. Uma owesifazane ethole ukuthi babanga indoda eyodwa nomunye, ulwisa umnakwabo hhayi indoda." Uveze ukuthi kumele ngabe yindoda okuliwa nayo ngoba iyona eshelayo kodwa akwenzeki lokho. "Kuke kwaduma indaba yokubizana ngo-star kwabesifazane ababanga indoda. Lelo gama alipheli ngisho indoda ingasathandani nabo. Uma abesifazane beke babanga indoda abaphinde bazwane. Abafana kwesinye isikhathi uma bebanga intombi bagcina bezwana bodwa, babone owesifazane kunguye onephutha bambize nangamagama alumelayo." Umbhali uNksz Nancy Roxanne waseKenya, esihlokweni esikhuluma ngombango wamadoda kwi-website, i-Eve Woman uthe kuwubuwula ukuthi abesifazane balwe bodwa. Uthe kumele balwise indoda bobabili. Uthe indoda emthanda ngempela owesifazane ngeke imbeke esimeni sokuthi kumele ancintisane nomunye othandweni. "Kuyihlazo futhi kwehlisa isithunzi ukubona abesifazane abahle bechitha isikhathi ngokubanga indoda. Abanye bathukana ngisho ezinkundleni zokuxhumana bebanga indoda yona esuke iziphumulele. Uma ujola kumele wazi ukuthi asikho isiqiniseko sokuthi indoda izothembeka kuwena." Ukhuthaza ukuthi uma owesifazane ebamba ukuthi indoda imbhangqile, ungalinge ulwise umnakwenu, ilwa nendoda. Uthe abanye baze baqhoshelane ngokuthi ubani oyintombi yangempela neshende kodwa iqiniso ukuthi bobabili basuke benziwe izilima yindoda. "Asikho isicoco sokulwela indoda.
